description: The eligibility checker could not be opened from the UI: its modal was rendered only when a state variable was set, and nothing ever set it.
fix: New inline EligibilityChecker on the scheme detail page (labelled fields, client validation, per-criterion results, demo-rule banner).

description: Every service card linked to /services/:id, which did not exist (404).
fix: Added the service detail page (description, honest fee/time section, documents, apply link, source).

description: Category options were hard-coded; 9 of 11 returned nothing.
fix: Options now come from GET /schemes/categories/list.

description: Category pills were hard-coded; 6 of 8 returned nothing and no categories endpoint existed.
fix: New GET /services/categories/list; pills built from it.

description: Accepted age -5, income -100, family size 0, oversized strings.
fix: Pydantic bounds and length limits (422).

description: Result colours used dynamically composed Tailwind class names (not generated, so the result box was unstyled); labels not associated with inputs; no dialog semantics.
fix: Replaced by the new component with fixed class maps and real label/for associations.

description: Horizontal scrolling of 33 px and 3 px at 390 px width (search form, long department badge).
fix: Wrapping forms, min-w-0, truncating badges with tooltips.
regression_test: audit_fixes.spec 'no horizontal scrolling on a phone' (4 pages)

description: Search inputs had no accessible name (placeholder only).
fix: aria-label on each; role=search on forms.

description: Quality scores rendered as 10000% (0-100 values multiplied by 100 again); scores presented as measurements although they are seeded values.
fix: Correct scale, clamped; disclaimer that the scores are recorded in the registry, not computed.

description: The query textarea had no accessible name.
fix: aria-label added.

description: Required fields were marked with an asterisk only; not exposed to assistive technology.
fix: aria-required on Subject and Description (custom messages kept).

description: Protected API calls were made (and failed 401/403) before the role guard redirected.
fix: Fetches wait for a permitted user.
regression_test: audit_fixes.spec 'no protected API calls before sign-in'

description: Heading levels skipped (h1 straight to h3).
fix: Section headings added (screen-reader only).

description: Default unstyled framework 404 page.
fix: Styled not-found page with links back.

description: The documented documentation URL returned 404 (docs live at /api/docs).
fix: Development-only redirects /docs -> /api/docs, /redoc -> /api/redoc; guide corrected.

description: Tailwind CSS was never compiled (no postcss.config.js): every page shipped unstyled.
fix: Added postcss.config.js; component classes moved into @layer components.
regression_test: full browser suite on the styled build (103 tests)

description: WCAG contrast failures (ghost buttons, saffron buttons, grey text) once styles applied.
fix: Palette and classes corrected.

description: Any officer could read and change complaints of any department.
fix: Department scoping in the service layer; unlinked staff refused.

description: Claimed to be an official government platform, showed invented amounts and a scheme not in the data, dead footer links.
fix: Truthful copy, dataset-only schemes, real links.

description: A blocking MinIO check starved the event loop, so Redis was reported unhealthy when MinIO was absent.
fix: MinIO probe runs in a thread; every check is time-bounded.

description: PostgreSQL's long Linux version() string was used as a display name and overflowed phone screens.
fix: Short parsed name; badges truncate.

description: Every open demo complaint was past target (data dated from a fixed reference time).
fix: New demo builds date data relative to now with recent open complaints (existing demo database untouched).

description: Tamil coverage is uneven (measured): landing page changes 2 of 98 text nodes; schemes/services/documents/assistant change only the navigation chrome; translations are unreviewed.
fix: Needs a human translator; not machine-translated on purpose.

description: No UI to create or edit schemes/services (the catalogue is read-only apart from the verification queue).
fix: Out of scope for this sprint; would also need an approval workflow.

description: Evidence upload returns 503 by design (object storage not implemented).
fix: Choose and verify an object-storage image first.

description: All government records are provisional; no official source evidence; fees/timings/eligibility rules unconfirmed.
fix: Needs a human reviewer with the official documents.

description: No LLM: answers are extractive over recorded records; anonymous chats cannot be re-opened (by design).
fix: Optional; needs an API key.

description: Redis, MinIO and Neo4j are not running in the local demo; no real boundary polygons are loaded.
fix: Docker Compose runs Redis/Neo4j; boundaries need authoritative data.

description: Public-deployment items remain open: in-process rate limits, refresh tokens in localStorage, no MFA, no password reset or e-mail verification, no TLS.
fix: Not required for the university demo; mandatory before any public use.

description: The sweep flags /admin as 'rendered' for non-admins: it renders an explicit 'Access denied'/'sign-in required' message and no data (tested, API also refuses).
fix: False positive of the generic check; no change.
